name: reflect
doc: Compile-time and run-time reflection: type information, fields, methods, attributes and dynamic values.

items.name: Error
items.doc:
Error stops compilation with msg (a constant string) when the call is
reachable after compile-time folding: a library-level static_assert.
items.summary: Error stops compilation with msg (a constant string) when the call is reachable after compile-time folding: a library-level static_assert.

items.name: Fields
items.doc:
Compile-time field list of struct T: only as the sequence of a for loop
inside a generic function (unrolled at instantiation).
items.summary: Compile-time field list of struct T: only as the sequence of a for loop inside a generic function (unrolled at instantiation).

items.name: TypeOf
items.doc: TypeOf returns the type information of T (computed at compile time).
items.summary: TypeOf returns the type information of T (computed at compile time).

items.name: TypesWith
items.doc:
TypesWith returns every type of the program (all packages) declared
with attribute A, by package, file and declaration order (computed at
compile time; a constant slice).
items.summary: TypesWith returns every type of the program (all packages) declared with attribute A, by package, file and declaration order (computed at compile time; a constant slice).

items.name: ValueOf
items.doc: ValueOf returns a Value for the dynamic value of x.
items.summary: ValueOf returns a Value for the dynamic value of x.

members.name: Attribute
members.doc: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the field, or nil.
members.summary: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the field, or nil.

members.name: Attributes
members.doc: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the field.
members.summary: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the field.

items.name: Kind
items.doc:
Kind of a type (TypeInfo.Kind). `int64` is `int`, `uint64` is `Uint`,
`byte` is `Uint8`, `float64` is `Float`.

members.name: Params
members.doc: The parameters without the receiver.
members.summary: The parameters without the receiver.

members.name: Attribute
members.doc: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the method, or nil.
members.summary: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the method, or nil.

members.name: Attributes
members.doc: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the method.
members.summary: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the method.

members.name: Invoke
members.doc:
m.Call(recv, args...) is lowered to this: the arguments are boxed
into a []any; the result (if any) is boxed into an any.
members.summary: m.Call(recv, args...) is lowered to this: the arguments are boxed into a []any; the result (if any) is boxed into an any.

members.name: Call
members.doc: Call returns the method as a function value of type F; it panics if F is not its type.
members.summary: Call returns the method as a function value of type F; it panics if F is not its type.

members.name: Attribute
members.doc: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the parameter, or nil.
members.summary: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the parameter, or nil.

members.name: Attributes
members.doc: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the parameter.
members.summary: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the parameter.

items.name: TypeInfo
items.doc:
The static description of a type. The first three words are the
runtime's zell_type_info header (runtime/ABI.md section 17).
items.summary: The static description of a type.

members.name: Package
members.doc: Namespace path of the declaration (empty for builtin and composite types).
members.summary: Namespace path of the declaration (empty for builtin and composite types).

members.name: Attribute
members.doc: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the type, or nil.
members.summary: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the type, or nil.

members.name: Attributes
members.doc: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the type.
members.summary: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the type.

members.name: Field
members.doc: Field returns the field called name, or nil.
members.summary: Field returns the field called name, or nil.

members.name: Method
members.doc: Method returns the method called name, or nil.
members.summary: Method returns the method called name, or nil.

members.name: Variant
members.doc: Variant returns the enum variant called name, or nil.
members.summary: Variant returns the enum variant called name, or nil.

members.name: New
members.doc: New returns a pointer to a new zero value of the type (as `any`); it panics if the type cannot be instantiated.
members.summary: New returns a pointer to a new zero value of the type (as `any`); it panics if the type cannot be instantiated.

members.name: Same
members.doc: Same reports whether both describe the same type.
members.summary: Same reports whether both describe the same type.

members.name: String
members.doc: String returns the type name.
members.summary: String returns the type name.

items.name: Value
items.doc:
A reference to a value: its address, its type and an owner keeping the
memory alive.
items.summary: A reference to a value: its address, its type and an owner keeping the memory alive.

members.name: IsValid
members.doc: IsValid reports whether the value holds something (ValueOf(nil) is invalid).
members.summary: IsValid reports whether the value holds something (ValueOf(nil) is invalid).

members.name: Field
members.doc: Field returns field name of a struct value; it panics for other values.
members.summary: Field returns field name of a struct value; it panics for other values.

members.name: Get
members.doc: Get returns the value as a T; it panics if the type is not T.
members.summary: Get returns the value as a T; it panics if the type is not T.

members.name: Set
members.doc: Set stores v; it panics if the type is not T or the value is not addressable.
members.summary: Set stores v; it panics if the type is not T or the value is not addressable.

members.name: Attribute
members.doc: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the variant, or nil.
members.summary: Attribute returns the attribute of type A on the variant, or nil.

members.name: Attributes
members.doc: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the variant.
members.summary: Attributes returns every attribute of type A on the variant.
